title: SCA Minhag of the Week 296: "Pesah Sheni & Ribbi Meir Baal Hanes"

summary: Joseph Mosseri discusses the background of Pesach Sheni and its later association with Rabbi Meir Ba'al HaNess. He also explores the history of the Kupah of Rabbi Meir Ba'al HaNess and the halachic ruling made by the rabbis of Halab.
subjects: Kupah of Rabbi Meir Ba'al HaNess
questions: What is the origin and significance of Pesach Sheni?
How did Rabbi Meir Ba'al HaNess become associated with Pesach Sheni?
What was the Kupah of Rabbi Meir Ba'al HaNess used for in Halab?
What did the rabbis of Halab rule in 1954 regarding charity funds?
